flag_note: Each entry has "class" (structure category), "building" (true = a habitable building; false = non-dwelling structure such as a church, bridge, monument or wall), and "use" (residential | commercial | mixed | unknown, for buildings only). The headline density estimate counts residential + unknown use. Filter on these for a map overlay.
note: Heritage designation is devolved. This dataset covers England (Historic England) and Wales (Cadw) only. Scottish listed buildings and conservation areas are held by Historic Environment Scotland and are not included.
